recommendation.actualHoursRule: min(target, verified usable hours of every language, including Gujarati)
recommendation.why: 25 hours is a bounded first shared-student experiment; 10 hours is a smoke-test fallback. Exact availability and speaker diversity are not assumed.
recommendation.gujaratiConstraint: Gujarati is capped at 1791 source utterances before filtering and split reservation; its measured usable duration and speaker count must cap all languages for a balanced run.
recommendation.speakerRule: select speakers first with deterministic seed and per-speaker cap; reserve disjoint speakers for validation and test; do not claim balance before audit

strategies.name: equal utterance count
strategies.rule: use the smallest verified usable utterance count; not equal hours

strategies.name: equal estimated hours
strategies.rule: use the smallest verified usable duration; duration estimates are not yet available

strategies.name: speaker-balanced multilingual
strategies.rule: common hours plus per-speaker caps and gender/scenario/task strata where supported

strategies.name: maximum under 2:1
strategies.rule: maximize usable hours subject to max/min language hours <= 2; requires exact audit

selectionRules.splits: preserve source test only after speaker-overlap audit; otherwise reserve test then validation speakers from training pool
selectionRules.quality: configurable deterministic rejection rules for corruption, sample rate, silence, duration, SNR, C50, CER, transcript, duplicates, and speaker ID; thresholds require distribution and linguist review

storagePlanning.formula: hours * sample_rate_hz * 2 bytes for mono 16-bit PCM
storagePlanning.reserveRecommendation: at least 2x the raw bound for staging, validation, indexes, and transformed copies
storagePlanning.compression: unknown until legally approved acquisition; do not assume WAV/FLAC savings

provenance.license: CC-BY-4.0 declaration is conditional evidence, not trained-weight redistribution approval
provenance.legalGate: BLOCKED pending source integrity, consent/privacy, attribution, derivative-model, APK, and product/legal review
